summary: Cornwall Lookout in Cornwall Hills Provincial Park near Cache Creek: late-1950s fire lookout, staffed until the 1990s, saved from dismantling and repaired by volunteers.

facts.design: Originally a one-storey building; later built up to two storeys, with the original forming the base

access.note: In Cornwall Hills Provincial Park, which has no camping or day-use facilities and is not regularly serviced or patrolled; off-road vehicle travel is prohibited. Managed with the Four Wheel Drive Association of BC under a partnership agreement.

visit.trail_note: BC Parks route notes: road from the Hat Creek Road turn-off, impassable in rainy periods in places; the road ends in a meadow where the last couple of kilometres must be hiked. Check conditions before going.

events.note: August 1955 photographs show the original one-storey building already standing (2019 article).
By 1999 the only active forest service lookout tower in the Kamloops fire district (2016 article).
Last use during the 2003 wildfire in the Cornwall Hills; NHLR says used on occasion until 2003.
BC Parks proposed demolition or dismantling; the Four Wheel Drive Association of BC then took over management (2019 article says 2015; 2016 article suggests paperwork that year).
NHLR visit report (September 4, 2016): good condition, not staffed, no directions sign.
Volunteer work bee on August 17, 2019: stairs, two posts and a beam replaced; most of upper exterior repainted.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, March 24, 2020.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR and the 2016 article say the current building dates to the late 1950s. A 2019 article's 1955 photograph shows the original one-storey building already standing. The story gives the late-1950s date from the register and the 1955 photograph as a separate fact.

A 2019 article says the Four Wheel Drive Association took over management in 2015. A 2016 article says the paperwork was signed a couple of weeks before publication, and BC Parks says a partnership was in place as of 2016. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Build date conflict: NHLR and the 2016 article say late 1950s; the 2019 article's 1955 photograph shows the original one-storey building, so the build may be earlier than the register says. A 2016 Facebook group post (not read or cited) gives full-time staffing from 1950 to 1988; that conflicts with the register and was left out as unverified. Drive access: BC Parks' route notes mention both a road to the lookout and a hike of the last couple of kilometres; the story reports BC Parks' words. Current access and condition rest on a 2019 article and a 2016 visit report; no source read is newer. The NHLR 'Visit Reports' and firelookout.ca were checked; firelookout.ca gives no details. The 2016 article's 'since the 1890s' is a decade, not a year, so no 1890 event was added.
